import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 198a

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture198a

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 198a](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, if `b(G) ≤ 2 + ecc_avg(G)`, then `G` has a Hamiltonian path.
Here `b(G)` is the number of vertices in a largest induced bipartite subgraph, and
`ecc_avg(G)` is the average eccentricity of `G`.
A Hamiltonian path is a walk visiting every vertex exactly once.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture198a (G : SimpleGraph α) (h : G.Connected)
    (hb : b G ≤ 2 + averageEccentricity G) :
    ∃ a b : α, ∃ p : G.Walk a b, p.IsHamiltonian := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The `averageEccentricity` invariant is nonneg for any graph. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ averageEccentricity G := by
  unfold averageEccentricity
  positivity

/-- The invariant `b G` is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ b G := Nat.cast_nonneg _

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture198a

reformulations.difference: The conclusion quantifies over a walk satisfying IsHamiltonian rather than explicitly requiring a simple path spanning all vertices.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Mathlib's Walk.IsHamiltonian requires every vertex to occur exactly once in the walk's support. This implies both IsPath and membership of every vertex in the support; conversely, those two properties imply IsHamiltonian. The full equivalence between the existential conclusions was proved as reviewHamiltonianConclusionIff in /workspace/review/scratch.lean, without using the conjecture.

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Sophie-heuristic introduction and Conjectures 198/198a, archived 26 July 2026: http://web.archive.org/web/20260726061534id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html

review.notes:
The conjecture and both anonymous sanity checks were checked. The source explicitly assumes n > 1, matching Nontrivial α, and states exactly b(G) ≤ 2 + ecc_avg(G) ⇒ existence of a Hamiltonian path. Its definitions of bipartite number and average eccentricity agree with the imported definitions. Finiteness makes the supremum defining b an attained maximum; connectedness keeps eccentricities finite, and the vertex assumptions exclude division by zero.

/workspace/review/scratch.lean compiles successfully. Tests included empty and singleton graphs, complete graphs, P3 (average eccentricity 5/3), P6 (average 4), and the claw (b = 4, average 7/4, so its premise fails). Independent exact enumeration found no counterexamples among connected labeled graphs on 2–5 vertices.

The live cited server redirected to an unreachable HTTPS endpoint, so source verification used archived primary material. The retrieved July 2026 source marks 198a O (open), with the remark that it was superseded. The solved neighboring entry 198 concerns a different average and should not be confused with 198a.
